facts.statement: A community Trick or Treat party was held in Sanctuary as part of the 2nd Annual Super Spooktacular, with daily Trick or Treat quests and candy handed out by shop owners and Halloween Harry.
facts.quote: The 2nd Annual Super Spooktacular continues with an awesome Trick or Treating party in Sanctuary!

facts.statement: The US and Latin America session of the party was on Thursday October 21, 2010 at 3pm Pacific Time on Server 1.
facts.quote: Thursday October 21st , 2010 3pm Pacific Time (U.S. and Latin America) Server 1

facts.statement: The UK and Europe session of the party was on Friday October 22, 2010 at 9:00am Pacific Time (4:00pm GMT) on Server 1.
facts.quote: Friday October 22nd, 2010 9:00am Pacific Time / 4:00pm GMT (UK and Europe) Server 1

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? (Community Event: Sanctuary Trick or Treat Party)
article_summaries.summary: An official SOE news post announcing a community Trick or Treat party in Sanctuary during the 2010 Super Spooktacular Halloween event. The Community Team and friends were to attend in costume with Chiller Boomboxes, and the daily Trick or Treat quests were offered there. The article gives two dated server 1 sessions, one for the US and Latin America and one for the UK and Europe.
